review.selection_rule: Require no collision detections/XML events/teleports, no unfinished or pending trips and exact expected completions on every validation seed; minimize mean completed-trip waiting time across validation seeds; tie-break lower training steps then candidate ID. Test seeds are excluded from selection.

full_training_curve.criterion: at least 40 complete episodes; last-two-10-episode mean drift <=10%, last-20 CV <=25%, final mean improves on initial mean
full_training_curve.interpretation: empirical training-curve plateau heuristic, not a proof of optimality or safety
